name: omkareswar-realtors-backend
description: Backend API for OMKARESWAR REALTORS real-estate platform

scripts.db:create:test: node -e "import('pg').then(({default: pg}) => { const client = new pg.Client({ host: 'localhost', port: 5432, user: 'postgres', password: 'user', database: 'postgres' }); client.connect().then(() => client.query('CREATE DATABASE omkareswar_realtors_test').then(() => { console.log('DB_TEST_CREATED'); client.end(); process.exit(0); }).catch(err => { console.log('CREATE_FAILED:', err.message); client.end(); process.exit(0); })).catch(err => { console.log('CONN_FAILED:', err.message); process.exit(1); }); })"
scripts.db:reset:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && cross-env NODE_ENV=test sequelize-cli db:migrate && cross-env NODE_ENV=test sequelize-cli db:seed:all
scripts.db:rules: node -e "import('./src/models/index.js').then(({ MediaRule, MediaRuleCommonSlot }) => MediaRule.findAll({ include: [{ model: MediaRuleCommonSlot, as: 'commonSlots' }] }).then(rules => console.log('RULES_COUNT:', rules.length, JSON.stringify(rules.map(r => ({ ruleKey: r.ruleKey, slotsCount: r.commonSlots?.length })), null, 2))).catch(err => console.error(err)))"
scripts.db:rules:detail: node -e "import('./src/models/index.js').then(({ MediaRule, MediaRuleCommonSlot }) => MediaRule.findOne({ where: { ruleKey: 'agriculturalLand' }, include: [{ model: MediaRuleCommonSlot, as: 'commonSlots' }] }).then(rule => console.log('SLOTS:', JSON.stringify(rule.commonSlots.map(s => ({ slotKey: s.slotKey, required: s.required })), null, 2))).catch(err => console.error(err)))"
